description: Projected one-core solve times for extruded GMRES cases without a converged CPU run. Projected CPU time = (CPU seconds per inner iteration per cell-moment of the first available basis run) x (cells x moments of the target) x (GH200 inner iterations of the target). A basis is either a CPU run that stopped at the 5000-iteration GMRES cap (timed below; its 5000 iterations are full restart cycles of the first outer iteration) or a converged CPU run in data/perf. A target is projected only while no converged CPU run of it exists. Read by make_figures.py.
